payload.zoningSummary: The R-1 single family residential district is intended to create, preserve, and enhance areas suitable for detached dwellings with a strong presence of nature and with open area affording maximum privacy and opportunities for outdoor living and childrens play. Minimum site area requirements are established to create and preserve variety among neighborhoods, to provide adequate open area, and to encourage quality design. Accessory du, junior accessory du and accessory structures or buildings are appropriate. Community uses and facilities, such as churches and schools, should be limited unless no net loss of housing would result.
payload.permittedUses: PERMITTED USES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO: HOUSING - SINGLE UNIT, HOUSING - MULTIPLE UNITS, HOUSING - SENIOR, HOUSING - MOBILE HOME PARK
payload.zoningDensityFarFullDescription: First 5,000 sq ft of lot size: 0.45; Sq footage of lot size in excess of 5,000 sq ft: 0.30; Residential Density: 1 unit, except as provided in Section 18.12.090
payload.maximumSiteCoverageFullDescription: Single story development and With S Combining: Equivalent to maximum allowable floor area ratio, The covering of a court is exempt from the calculation of site coverage provided that the court existed prior to July 20, 1978; Multiple story development: 35 Percent
payload.frontSetbackFullDescription: The minimum front yard setback shall be the greater of 20 ft or the average setback, if the average front setback is 30 ft or more. Average setback means the average distance between the front property line and the first main structural element, including covered porches, on sites on the same side of the block, including existing structures on the subject parcel. This calculation shall exclude flag lots and existing multifamily developments of 3 units or more. For calculation purposes, if 5 or more properties on the block are counted, the single greatest and the single least setbacks shall be excluded. The street sideyard setback of corner lots that have the front side of their parcel the narrowest street-facing lot line facing another street shall be excluded from the calculations. For blocks longer than 600 ft, the average setback shall be based on no more than ten sites located on the same side of the street and nearest to the subject property, plus the subject site, and for a distance no greater than 600 ft. Blocks with 3 or fewer eligible parcels are not subject to contextual setbacks. Structures on the site in no case may be located closer than 20 ft from the front property line.
payload.sideSetbackFullDescription: Interior Side Yard: 6 ft; Street Side Yard: 16 ft
payload.maximumBuildingHeightFullDescription: Standard: 30 ft; Maximum Height for buildings with a roof pitch of 12.00 or greater: 33 ft; R-1 Floodzone Heights: Provided, in a special flood hazard area as defined in Chapter 16.52, the maximum heights are increased by one-half of the increase in elevation required to reach base flood elevation, up to a maximum building height of 33 ft.

payload.zoningSummary: The PF public facilities district is designed to accommodate governmental, public utility, educational, and community service or recreational facilities.
payload.permittedUses: PERMITTED USES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO: HOUSING - MULTIPLE UNITS, PUBLIC SERVICE, PARK & OPEN SPACE
payload.zoningDensityFarFullDescription: 1.00; Provided that, for parking facilities the maximum floor area ratio and site coverage shall be equal to the floor area ratio and site coverage established by the most restrictive adjacent district. See Section 18.28.060 e for exceptions to these development standards; Residential Density: No requirement established
payload.maximumSiteCoverageFullDescription: 30 Percent; Provided that, for parking facilities the maximum floor area ratio and site coverage shall be equal to the floor area ratio and site coverage established by the most restrictive adjacent district. See Section 18.28.060 e for exceptions to these development standards.
payload.frontSetbackFullDescription: The minimum front yard in the PF public facilities district shall be equal to the respective front, side, and rear yards required in the most restrictive abutting district; provided, that no yard adjoining a street shall be less than 20 ft and that no interior yard shall be less than 10 ft. See Section 18.28.060 (e) for exceptions to these development standards.

See Section 18.28.060 (e) for exceptions to these development standards.
payload.rearSetbackFullDescription: The minimum rear yard in the PF public facilities district shall be equal to the respective front, side, and rear yards required in the most restrictive abutting district; provided, that no yard adjoining a street shall be less than 20 ft and that no interior yard shall be less than 10 ft. See Section 18.28.060 (e) for exceptions to these development standards.
